messages:
Dana (Sales): Quick handoff: I closed IonGrid (mid-market). Contract signed today. They need a 30-day dedicated pilot + SSO (Okta) + VPC peering. Sharing context here.
Ravi (CS): awesome, congrats. please include go-live target and any hard constraints.
Dana (Sales): Go-live target 7 weeks. ARR $95k. Hard constraints: EU data residency (eu-west-1), latency target gen p95 <120ms, embeddings throughput high. Legal signed DPA.
Maya (Support): tagging owners: Ravi = CS lead; Maya = infra/support; Eli = runtime eng. I'll open infra ticket now.
Eli (Eng): need expected QPS and sequence lengths to plan batching. Also want a sample prompt set (20-50 queries).
Dana (Sales): profile: steady 45 QPS, peak 85 QPS, avg seq 200 tokens, embeddings ~50% of calls. Will ask PM for sample payloads.
Ravi (CS): I'll prepare onboarding runbook + enablement session (90 min). Also collecting Okta metadata. Dana pls share IdP XML when received.
Maya (Support): infra checklist (adding to TICKET-90711):
- provision 2x GPU nodes (GPU-equivalent) in eu-west-1
- configure VPC peering and private DNS
- setup SAML SP with provided IdP metadata
- allocate staging subdomain + TLS cert
- enable prefix caching for embeddings
Maya (Support): provisioning ETA 3 business days pending quotas.
Eli (Eng): perf plan: warm KV cache, dynamic batching, and a quantized fallback. target p50 <80ms, p95 <150ms. If we miss p95, escalate to eng-oncall.
Ravi (CS): risk flags: data residency = HIGH, latency sensitivity = MED. Renewal risk low-now but could rise if pilot fails.
Deploy Bot: Created channel #inc-6123600000-iongrid-pilot and linked TICKET-90711.
Maya (Support): ticket created. I'll update with network contact and provisioning window once scheduled.
Dana (Sales): final: they want a cost estimate for 3-month pilot vs steady state. Ravi can you add a slide to kickoff pack?
Ravi (CS): will do. Owners & next steps: Dana -> deliver IdP + prompt set; Maya -> provision infra (TICKET-90711); Eli -> run baseline perf after infra ready; Ravi -> onboarding doc + schedule enablement.
Ravi (CS): I'll post updates to #customer-iongrid and close loop here. :white_check_mark:
